text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"And now, for the latest news. 
First up, footage from the press 
conference of the 
current reigning champion horsegirl that 
shook the world."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! 
Here it comes.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Following the Japan Cup, 
I will be stepping down from the front 
lines!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Or rather, it might end up being my last 
race. 
That's just how much resolve I'm bringing 
to this challenge! 
—Against that girl."

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"Almond Eye, the fifth Triple Tiara 
horsegirl 
in history, has achieved an unprecedented 
feat of 
eight turf GⅠ victories, unmatched by 
anyone."

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
"A living legend who has etched a glorious 
legacy 
into Twinkle Series history! And the one 
she 
has named for her final showdown is—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Daring Tact. 
The moment I heard you'd be there, I 
decided to run without hesitation. 
—Along with the resolve to stake my 
absolute best."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"I saw your Triple Tiara victory. 
—It set my soul on fire!"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"These difficult times that began last 
year... 
The darkness still hasn't cleared. But—"

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"When Daring Tact claimed the Triple 
Tiara... 
I felt a faint light kindle in my heart."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"As a fellow Triple Tiara horsegirl, 
I offer my utmost respect to her 
achievement."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"She's an incredible horsegirl. 
A strong horsegirl. And that is why—I want 
to win."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"Against all the girls who stand at the 
absolute pinnacle! 
And I don't care if I exhaust everything I 
have to do it."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"With me at my absolute peak right now... 
I will win against everything!"

I knew there was a high chance we'd clash 
with Almond Eye. 
However, I never expected it to be a race 
where she 
might step down from the front lines...
choice_data_list:
(She wants to win, even if it burns up 
everything she has...)

text_block_list.text:
A direct callout from the strongest active 
horsegirl— 
For anyone other than Daring Tact, the 
pressure 
would have been crushing. But—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye herself 
acknowledges my strength...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It is truly an honor. 
...Now I'm more motivated than ever!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If I can triumph over Almond Eye, 
I can become an unshakeable light... 
One that won't yield even to the winds of 
Cape Erimo.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I will win. 
I'll show that I can beat even Almond Eye!

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Well, things sure got huge, didn't they? 
That's all everyone back here can talk 
about!"

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
"Even the kids around here know how 
amazing Almond Eye is... 
Are you holding up all right, Daring 
Tact...?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes... She is exceptionally strong, 
but I have no intention of losing.

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
"Whoa... Look at you, all grown up! 
Well, you were always a dependable girl, 
but... 
now you've got this almost divine presence 
about you."

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
"Hey now, don't hog all the talk, you 
guys... 
We've got a special guest today!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text: "—Tact?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Mother...! 
Are you feeling well enough?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, I've been feeling wonderful lately. 
It's surely 
thanks to all the lovely news you've sent 
my way."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Honestly... you never cease to amaze me. 
You've always been so honest and oddly 
bold since you were little... 
Like lining up caterpillars on my bed."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: P-Please don't bring that up anymore...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, I know. 
You were just trying to cheer me up, 
weren't you? 
You really are—such a sweet girl."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to you, Hidaka is so... lively 
right now. 
Whenever anyone talks about you, 
their faces... just light up with joy."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone keeps saying it's their turn to 
do their best... 
So, Tact. Please, just don't push yourself 
too hard. 
You've already accomplished something 
truly incredible."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...No, Mother. Not yet. 
I'm going to bring you even more wonderful 
news.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please watch over me. 
Until the day—we can meet again.

Taking the circumstances into account, the 
URA 
further eased attendance restrictions at 
the racetrack.

The cap was just under 5,000 people. A 
clash between 
the strongest horsegirl and the new Triple 
Tiara winner... 
Under normal conditions, a crowd of 
100,000 would have gathered.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Gaaah... I wanted to see the clash of the 
century in person! 
No matter who wins, this is gonna be 
talked about forever...!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
And every single other runner is top-tier 
too! 
Man, what kind of insane race is this 
gonna be...?!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
For! Real! I wanted to go so bad~... but 
...lost the lottery, so nothing I can do 
about it.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"To all my comrades who lost the lottery! 
Let's hype it up 
in the watch party~!" ...And post! 
Whoa, already got likes?! The hype is 
real!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
"Truly the match of the century. First 
off, thank you to all the horsegirls 
who chose to run in this race. 
I'll be cheering through the screen!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible, the posts just keep rolling 
in... 
Oh, it's trending too...!
choice_data_list:
The attention on this is absolutely 
unreal.

The attention on this is absolutely 
unreal.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is placing so much hope on this. 
They've been waiting for our race with 
bated breath...
choice_data_list:
We've got to answer them with our best 
run.

We've got to answer them with our best 
run.

text_block_list.text:
We had already gone over all the race 
strategies, 
and Daring Tact was more than fired up. 
All that was left was to send her off with 
confidence.
choice_data_list: Today, you might be the challenger.
Today, you might be the challenger.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...That's true.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Not just Almond Eye, but everyone else 
too... 
Every one of our seniors possesses peak 
strength, after all.
choice_data_list:
Even so, I believe you're the strongest of 
all!

Even so, I believe you're the strongest of 
all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! 
...Tore-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You truly have always... 
believed in me, haven't you?
choice_data_list: Of course. Let's begin your era!
Of course. Let's begin your era!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes! 
I'll do my very best!

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
...Are you curious about the Japan Cup as 
well, 
Titleholder?

text_block_list.name: Efforia
text_block_list.text:
I wonder what kind of race the great 
Almond Eye 
will deliver for her finale—

text_block_list.name: Titleholder
text_block_list.text:
No. 
What I want to see is...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (Clap, clap, clap, clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Whoa...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(There are even more people here than at 
the Shuka Sho. 
...Little by little, step by step...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Everyone is so intensely focused... 
Alright, I have to—)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: (—Clap, clap!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh! 
This incredible presence—

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact! 
We finally meet here, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Did you watch the press conference, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(The temperature of their anticipation 
just shifted! 
The warmth I felt up until now has...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Turned into a ferocious heat... 
Hot enough to burn...!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
—Daring Tact? 
Are you alright?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
(She's taking in this blazing heat— 
without batting an eye.)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...I'm fine. 
And of course, I watched your conference.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Splendid! Then you understand 
my feelings perfectly well, right?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You've been at the very top this entire 
time, haven't you? 
But you see, true "strength" has no 
ceiling.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm stronger today than I was yesterday. 
So come at me—with everything you've got!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh. 
Of course!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
As the reigning Triple Tiara horsegirl... 
I will defeat you and usher in a brand new 
era!
